application_purpose_summary.elevator_pitch: COVE User Service is a reactive Spring Boot microservice that manages user authentication, registration, and onboarding workflows for the COVE platform. It provides JWT-based authentication with role-based access control (CUSTOMER and ADMIN roles), an admin-approval workflow for new user registrations, and integrates with external systems for performance data retrieval and email notifications.

primary_capabilities.name: User Registration and Onboarding
primary_capabilities.description: New users register with personal and company information. Registrations enter a pending_approval state and trigger email notifications. Admins review and approve or reject registrations, with automated email notifications sent at each status change.

primary_capabilities.name: JWT-Based Authentication
primary_capabilities.description: Users authenticate with email and password. The system issues short-lived access tokens (30 minutes) and long-lived refresh tokens (24 hours). Tokens are stored in the database with expiration and revocation tracking. Token refresh and revocation endpoints support session management.

primary_capabilities.name: Admin User Management
primary_capabilities.description: Admins can update user onboarding status (approve/reject), activate or deactivate user accounts, change user roles (CUSTOMER/ADMIN), retrieve user details, and view paginated user lists with filtering by status, role, submission date, company, and active state.

primary_capabilities.name: Audit and Action History
primary_capabilities.description: All administrative actions on user accounts (onboarding status changes, account activation/deactivation, role changes) are logged with timestamps, admin attribution, and optional comments. Admins can retrieve paginated action history with filtering by status, role, date, company, name, and email.

primary_capabilities.name: External Performance Data Integration
primary_capabilities.description: The system integrates with the OneView API to retrieve project performance metrics and RAG (Red-Amber-Green) status data for specified accounts and project types. This capability supports performance monitoring and reporting.

out_of_scope_signals.signal: No password reset or forgot password functionality detected

processes.name: User Registration
processes.description: A new user submits registration information including personal details, company, and credentials. The system validates the email uniqueness, hashes the password, stores the user record with pending_approval status, and sends a pending approval email notification.

actors.name: Prospective User
actors.notes: Individual registering for COVE platform access

actors.name: COVE User Service
actors.notes: Handles registration logic, validation, and email notification

steps.name: Validate Email Uniqueness
steps.business_description: System checks if the provided email address is already registered. If duplicate, registration fails.
steps.authorization_notes: Public endpoint; no authentication required

steps.name: Hash Password
steps.business_description: System hashes the user's password using BCrypt before storage.
steps.authorization_notes: Password hashing follows BCrypt standard

steps.name: Store User Record
steps.business_description: System creates a new user record with onboarding status set to pending_approval and isActive set to false.
steps.authorization_notes: Public endpoint; no authentication required

steps.name: Send Pending Approval Email
steps.business_description: System sends an email notification to the user informing them that their registration is pending admin approval.
steps.authorization_notes: Email sent via authenticated SMTP connection

variations_and_branches.condition_summary: If email already exists, registration fails with error
If email sending fails, registration still succeeds but user does not receive notification

outcomes.outcome: Registration successful; user awaits admin approval
Registration failed due to duplicate email

processes.name: User Login
processes.description: An approved and active user submits email and password credentials. The system validates credentials, checks onboarding status and account activation, revokes old tokens, generates new access and refresh tokens, stores them in the database, and returns tokens to the user.

actors.name: Registered User
actors.notes: User with approved onboarding status and active account

actors.name: COVE User Service
actors.notes: Handles authentication logic, token generation, and validation

steps.name: Validate User Exists
steps.business_description: System checks if a user record exists for the provided email. If not found, login fails.
steps.authorization_notes: Public endpoint; no authentication required

steps.name: Check Onboarding Status
steps.business_description: System checks the user's onboarding status. Only users with approved status can proceed. Users with pending_approval or reject status receive specific error messages.
steps.authorization_notes: Onboarding status gates access to authentication

steps.name: Check Account Active Status
steps.business_description: System checks if the user account is active. Deactivated accounts cannot log in.
steps.authorization_notes: Account activation status gates access to authentication

steps.name: Validate Password
steps.business_description: System compares the provided password with the stored BCrypt hash. If mismatch, login fails.
steps.authorization_notes: Password validation uses BCrypt comparison

steps.name: Revoke Old Tokens
steps.business_description: System revokes all existing access and refresh tokens for the user to enforce single-session behavior.
steps.authorization_notes: Token revocation ensures only one active session per user

steps.name: Generate Access Token
steps.business_description: System generates a new JWT access token with 30-minute validity and stores it in the database.
steps.authorization_notes: Access token signed with HS256 algorithm

steps.name: Generate Refresh Token
steps.business_description: System generates a new JWT refresh token with 24-hour validity and stores it in the database.
steps.authorization_notes: Refresh token signed with HS256 algorithm

steps.name: Return Tokens
steps.business_description: System returns the access token and refresh token to the user in the response payload.
steps.authorization_notes: Tokens transmitted over HTTPS

variations_and_branches.condition_summary: If user does not exist, login fails with 'Invalid username or password' error
If onboarding status is pending_approval, login fails with 'Please wait for approval' error
If onboarding status is reject, login fails with 'You have not been accepted' error
If account is deactivated, login fails with 'Account has been deactivated' error
If password does not match, login fails with 'Invalid username or password' error

outcomes.outcome: Login successful; user receives access and refresh tokens
Login failed due to invalid credentials, inactive account, or unapproved status

related_risks.risk_title: No rate limiting on login endpoint
No account lockout after failed login attempts

processes.name: Admin Approve or Reject User
processes.description: An admin reviews a pending user registration and updates the onboarding status to approved or reject. If approved, the user account is activated and an approval email is sent. If rejected, the account remains inactive and a rejection email with optional comments is sent. The action is logged in the action history.

actors.name: Admin
actors.notes: User with ADMIN role authorized to approve or reject registrations

actors.name: COVE User Service
actors.notes: Handles onboarding status update, email notification, and audit logging

actors.name: Gmail SMTP
actors.notes: Sends approval or rejection email notification

triggers.description: PUT /api/v1/admin/{toEmail}/onboarding-status with status parameter (approved or reject) and optional description

steps.name: Extract Admin Identity
steps.business_description: System extracts the admin's email from the JWT access token in the request header.
steps.authorization_notes: Requires valid JWT access token with ADMIN role

steps.name: Retrieve User Record
steps.business_description: System retrieves the user record by email. If not found, the operation fails.
steps.authorization_notes: Requires ADMIN role

steps.name: Update Onboarding Status
steps.business_description: System updates the user's onboarding status to the specified value (approved or reject). If approved, isActive is set to true. If rejected, isActive is set to false.
steps.authorization_notes: Requires ADMIN role

steps.name: Send Email Notification
steps.business_description: System sends an email notification to the user. If approved, sends approval email. If rejected, sends rejection email with optional description.
steps.authorization_notes: Email sent via authenticated SMTP connection

steps.name: Log Action History
steps.business_description: System creates an action history record with admin email, user email, new onboarding status, optional comments, and action type (UpdateOnBoardingStatus).
steps.authorization_notes: Audit log for compliance and traceability

variations_and_branches.condition_summary: If user does not exist, operation fails with 'User does not exist' error
If status is approved, user account is activated and approval email is sent
If status is reject, user account remains inactive and rejection email with description is sent
If status is pending_approval, user account is set to inactive

outcomes.outcome: User onboarding status updated successfully; email sent and action logged
Operation failed due to non-existent user

processes.name: Admin Manage User Account
processes.description: An admin activates or deactivates a user account, or changes a user's role. Each action is logged in the action history with admin attribution and optional comments.

actors.name: Admin
actors.notes: User with ADMIN role authorized to manage user accounts

actors.name: COVE User Service
actors.notes: Handles account status and role updates, and audit logging

triggers.description: PUT /api/v1/admin/{toEmail}/account-status with status parameter (true for activate, false for deactivate) and optional description
PUT /api/v1/admin/{toEmail}/role with role parameter (CUSTOMER or ADMIN) and optional description

steps.name: Extract Admin Identity
steps.business_description: System extracts the admin's email from the JWT access token in the request header.
steps.authorization_notes: Requires valid JWT access token with ADMIN role

steps.name: Retrieve User Record
steps.business_description: System retrieves the user record by email. If not found, the operation fails.
steps.authorization_notes: Requires ADMIN role

steps.name: Update Account Status or Role
steps.business_description: System updates the user's isActive field (for account status) or role field (for role change) based on the request.
steps.authorization_notes: Requires ADMIN role

steps.name: Log Action History
steps.business_description: System creates an action history record with admin email, user email, new status or role, optional comments, and action type (UpdateUserAccountStatus or UpdateUserRoleStatus).
steps.authorization_notes: Audit log for compliance and traceability

variations_and_branches.condition_summary: If user does not exist, operation fails with 'User does not exist' error
For account status update, isActive is set to true (activated) or false (deactivated)
For role update, role is set to CUSTOMER or ADMIN

outcomes.outcome: User account status or role updated successfully; action logged
Operation failed due to non-existent user

processes.name: Token Refresh
processes.description: A user with a valid refresh token requests a new access token. The system validates the refresh token, generates a new access token, and optionally generates a new refresh token. Old tokens are revoked.

actors.name: Authenticated User
actors.notes: User with a valid refresh token

actors.name: COVE User Service
actors.notes: Handles token validation, generation, and revocation

steps.name: Validate Refresh Token
steps.business_description: System validates the refresh token signature, expiration, and revocation status. If invalid, the operation fails.
steps.authorization_notes: Refresh token must be valid, not expired, and not revoked

steps.name: Generate New Access Token
steps.business_description: System generates a new JWT access token with 30-minute validity and stores it in the database.
steps.authorization_notes: New access token signed with HS256 algorithm

steps.name: Optionally Generate New Refresh Token
steps.business_description: System may generate a new refresh token and revoke the old one (token rotation strategy).
steps.authorization_notes: Token rotation enhances security

steps.name: Return New Tokens
steps.business_description: System returns the new access token and optionally new refresh token to the user.
steps.authorization_notes: Tokens transmitted over HTTPS

variations_and_branches.condition_summary: If refresh token is invalid, expired, or revoked, operation fails

outcomes.outcome: New access token (and optionally new refresh token) issued successfully
Token refresh failed due to invalid or expired refresh token

processes.name: Retrieve Performance Data
processes.description: A user requests project performance metrics and RAG status data for a specified account and optional project type. The system authenticates with the OneView API, retrieves the data, and returns filtered results.

actors.name: COVE User Service
actors.notes: Handles OneView API integration and data filtering

actors.name: OneView API
actors.notes: External API providing project performance and RAG status data

triggers.description: GET /performance with account and optional performanceType query parameters

steps.name: Authenticate with OneView API
steps.business_description: System sends a POST request to OneView API /user/signin with hardcoded credentials to obtain an access token.
steps.authorization_notes: Hardcoded credentials are a critical security risk

steps.name: Request Performance Data
steps.business_description: System sends a GET request to OneView API /ava/oneview/internal/api/dashboard/rag/list with current date and optional project type filter.
steps.authorization_notes: Requires OneView access token in X-Ava-Access-Token header

steps.name: Fallback to Previous Day
steps.business_description: If current day returns no data, system retries with previous day's date.
steps.authorization_notes: Fallback logic for data availability

steps.name: Filter by Account
steps.business_description: System filters the performance data to include only projects matching the specified account.
steps.authorization_notes: Client-side filtering

steps.name: Return Performance Data
steps.business_description: System returns the filtered performance data to the user.
steps.authorization_notes: Public endpoint; no authentication required

variations_and_branches.condition_summary: If current day returns no data, system retries with previous day
If project type is specified and not 'All', system filters by project type

outcomes.outcome: Performance data retrieved and returned successfully
Performance data retrieval failed due to OneView API error

related_risks.risk_title: Hardcoded OneView API credentials in source code

relationships.notes: User registration creates a pending_approval record that triggers the admin approval process.
Admin approval (with approved status) enables the user to log in.
User login issues a refresh token that can be used in the token refresh process.
Admin approval and account management are independent administrative processes that can occur in any order after registration.

faq.question: What happens when a user registers?
faq.answer: The user submits registration information via POST /register. The system validates email uniqueness, hashes the password, stores the user record with pending_approval status, and sends a pending approval email. The user cannot log in until an admin approves the registration.

faq.question: How does the admin approval workflow work?
faq.answer: Admins review pending registrations via GET /api/v1/admin/users with status filter pending_approval. They approve or reject users via PUT /api/v1/admin/{email}/onboarding-status. Approved users receive an approval email and can log in. Rejected users receive a rejection email with optional comments and cannot log in.

faq.question: What is the token lifecycle?
faq.answer: On login, the system issues an access token (30-minute validity) and a refresh token (24-hour validity). Access tokens authenticate API requests. When an access token expires, the user can request a new one via POST /refresh-token using the refresh token. Tokens can be revoked via POST /revoke-access-token or POST /revoke-refresh-token.

faq.question: What administrative actions are logged?
faq.answer: All onboarding status changes, account activation/deactivation, and role changes are logged in the action_history table with timestamps, admin attribution, and optional comments. Admins can retrieve action history via GET /api/v1/admin/action-history with filtering by status, role, date, company, name, and email.

faq.question: How does the system integrate with OneView?
faq.answer: The system authenticates with the OneView API using hardcoded credentials (security risk noted). It retrieves project performance and RAG status data for specified accounts and project types via GET /performance. If current day data is unavailable, it falls back to the previous day.
